title: The open factor of compact-support site comparison
statement:
The open factor of compact-support site comparison. In the fixed scalar presentation of finite constant coefficients and on the ordinary bounded-below derived categories, the specified canonical maps satisfy the following identity:

theorem compactSupportOpenFactor (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U' U Z' Z : Scheme.{u}} {v : U' ⟶ U} {j' : U' ⟶ Z'}
    {j : U ⟶ Z} {h : Z' ⟶ Z} [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (sq : IsPullback v j' j h)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    letI := Etale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) sq
    letI := sfFixedOpenExtensionBaseChange_isIso A sq
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) h).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((properOpenSiteExtensionIso (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) j).hom.app L) ≫
      ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso
          (asIso (sfFixedOpenExtensionBaseChange A sq.toCommSq)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).hom.app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) U).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
            L) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((fixedComparisonPullbackPlus (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) v).inv.app L) =
    (fixedComparisonPullbackPlus (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) h).inv.app
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj L) ≫
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) Z').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          (((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso
              (asIso (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) sq.toCommSq)).symm ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).hom.app L) ≫
      (properOpenSiteExtensionIso (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) j').hom.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) v).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
          L)

The direct-image and inverse-image comparisons are those of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and the open comparison is that of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].

proof.text: The pushforward square comparison is conjugate to the canonical inverse-image square: expand the three composition/congruence factors and use conjugateIsoEquiv_trans and conjugateIsoEquiv_upperStarComp. The iterated-mate identity then identifies the mate of the inverse-image square with the existing weakly-etale baseChangeMap. Taking the inverse conjugate identifies sfFixedOpenExtensionBaseChange with the underived map used by ordinaryOpenExtensionBaseChangeIso.

Apply fixSiteOpenExchange to the chosen open square associated with sq. Apply faithfulness of the inclusion of D+ in D. The exact-functor comparison isomorphisms restrict along this inclusion; their inverse components restrict as well by functoriality on isomorphisms. Substitute the preceding identification of underived open exchanges. mapDerivedCategoryNatIso preserves inverses by its localization construction. Expanding the two site comparisons and the exact derived square comparisons now gives precisely the claimed equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AF and 099R; restriction of fixSiteOpenExchange, with the two canonical underived mates identified using Mathlib Adjunction.Mates.
